title: Facebook posts and comments
description: One group, page, or profile post row with optional nested comments, or post and comment rows when commentsOutput is separate.

record_type.description: Indicates whether the dataset row represents a post or a comment as determined by the output mode.

surface_type.description: Identifies the kind of Facebook surface scraped, typically group, page, or profile, and is null when undetermined.

group_id.description: Holds the numeric Facebook identifier of the source group, null for page or profile sources.

group_url.description: Holds the canonical URL of the source Facebook group, null for page or profile sources.

group_name.description: Holds the display name of the source Facebook group at scrape time, null for page or profile sources or when unavailable.

source_profile_id.description: Holds the numeric Facebook identifier of the scraped page or profile, null for group sources or when unavailable.

source_profile_url.description: Holds the canonical URL of the scraped Facebook page or profile, null for group sources or when unavailable.

source_profile_name.description: Holds the display name of the scraped Facebook page or profile at scrape time, null when unavailable.

source_post_id.description: Gives the Facebook identifier of the origin post, matching the row itself for posts and the parent post for comments.

source_url.description: Holds the canonical Facebook URL of the origin post, null when it cannot be resolved.

created_at.description: Provides the publication time as an ISO 8601 timestamp string in UTC, null when unavailable.

creation_time.description: Provides the publication time as a Unix epoch timestamp in seconds, available as number or numeric string, null when unavailable.

raw_text.description: Contains the full untruncated textual content of the current post or comment, null when there is no text.

author.description: Contains structured information about the creator such as identifier, name, and profile URL, null when unavailable.

stats.description: Contains engagement counters such as likes, shares, and comment counts as reported by Facebook, null when unavailable.

media.description: Lists attached photos, videos, or other media objects with their URLs and types, null or empty when there are no attachments.

extracted_urls.description: Lists distinct external URLs detected inside the text content, null or empty when none were found.

comments.description: Lists nested comment objects collected for the post when inline comment expansion is enabled, null or empty otherwise.

comments_collected.description: Reports the number of comments actually stored in the output after filtering, in count units.

comments_collected_before_filters.description: Reports the number of comments retrieved before keyword or date filtering was applied, in count units.

comments_announced.description: Reports the total comment count displayed by Facebook for the post, in count units, null when not shown.

comments_coverage_percent.description: Expresses stored comments as a percentage from 0 to 100 relative to the announced total, null when incalculable.

comments_coverage_percent_before_budget.description: Expresses retrieved comments before per-post budget truncation as a percentage from 0 to 100 of the announced total, null when incalculable.

comments_truncated_by_budget.description: Reports how many comments were dropped because the per-post maximum limit was reached, in count units.

comments_blocked.description: Explains why comments could not be collected, for example disabled comments or access restriction, null when collection was possible.

post_text.description: Provides the parent post message for context when the row is a comment, null for post rows or when unavailable.
